name: Hen
note: The feral hen (docs/future/15), slice 1: a wary hen in the scrub, live only (src/world/hen). MODEL: Matt's supplied 'Chicken Rig' by FourthGreen (CC BY-NC 4.0, assets/models/hen/CREDITS.md), already in real metres (0.42 m tall, head toward +z). bones: the kept bones, each named for a joint of the file (its name without the number); every other joint folds into its nearest kept ancestor (the toes into each foot). The file's two wing joints carry no skin (its wings are part of the body), so they are not kept and her wings do not move apart from the body. The Idle clip plays from the file under the code clips (idleW: its share while she stands). body.displayScale 1.15 (Matt 2026-10-27: a hen just above the walker's knee); alphaCut: the feather edges' alpha below which nothing is drawn. HOME: the scrub, a cluster of at least minBushes gorse or grey willow bushes (species) at size minSize or more within clusterM of one another; she lives within rangeM of its middle and stays out of sight while the island has none (`?hen`, testing, unsaved: at once, testAheadM ahead of the view, living within testRangeM). LIFE (src/world/hen/life.js): by day she forages: walks to a seeded spot in her range, then scratches (two backward kicks, alternating feet, a step back, a look down with one eye, one to three pecks), cycles times, then stands a while (idleS) or walks on. WARY (presence): the walker inside wary.ringM (real metres, scaled by posture and gaze as other creatures' rings, and a tea's ringK) makes her freeze upright (alertS), then run (runMps) away from the walker and toward cover, until she is past calmM and has run at least fleeMinS; inside panicShare of the ring she runs at once. The camera above never startles her. At night (outside hours) she walks to the middle of the scrub and stands there. MOTION (src/world/hen/motion.js): code clips on her bones, timed to distance (a stride is strideM of travel, so feet never slide): the walk, the run (longer strides, body low), the kick, the peck, the look, the alert; and the head lock (headLock): while she walks her head holds still in the world, then jumps forward lockM.
